alternatives_rejected.why: E2 shows currencyservice own span self-time unchanged (0.14->0.14ms, 0.99x); CPU saturation would slow its own processing. Latency appears only in inbound caller-observed calls (39.9x).
E1 shows frontend latency elevated, but the far larger deviation is at currencyservice (z=408 vs 103), and E2 shows the delay is on calls into currencyservice, so frontend is a victim, not a source.
E1 shows checkoutservice latency-90 elevated (z=82) well below currencyservice (z=408), consistent with it being a caller of currencyservice and propagating the delay (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Locate and remove the source of added latency on the inbound path to currencyservice (e.g. injected delay, sidecar/network-policy or fault-injection config), using gated, reversible changes, and restart the pod only if the delay is confirmed to be in the pod itself.
steps: Compare currencyservice inbound span timings with its own span timings in traces to confirm the delay sits between caller and handler (E2), not inside the service code.

Inspect currencyservice pod/deployment config, sidecar/mesh settings (VirtualService, fault-injection, traffic shaping), and recent changes for any added delay; record current state before changing anything.
If a delay or fault-injection rule is found, disable or revert it via a human-approved config change (kubectl apply of the previous manifest).
If no config cause is found, with approval do a single rolling restart of the currencyservice deployment and watch latency-50/90.
Verify currencyservice_latency-50 returns toward baseline and that frontend and checkoutservice latency (E1) recover downstream.
preconditions: Confirm the latency increase is still ongoing in current metrics (E3).
Snapshot current deployment, mesh and network-policy manifests for currencyservice.
Confirm another replica or capacity exists so a rolling restart does not cause an outage.
Get on-call approval before any apply or restart.
proposed_fix.rollback: Reapply the saved previous manifests (kubectl apply of snapshot, or kubectl rollout undo deployment/currencyservice) and re-enable any config that was changed.
